picks: mag (102 magnetometers; MEG2143/MEG1112 are gradiometers); no re-referencing

preprocessing.tsss: Maxwell filtering in the validation only (standardised data are raw): bads = MEG2143, MEG1112 + find_bad_channels_maxwell on the first 120 s of each trial; maxwell_filter with the subject's fine-calibration (sub-XX_acq-calibration_meg.dat) and cross-talk (sub-XX_acq-crosstalk_meg.fif) from the download, tSSS st_duration 10 s, origin fitted to the head shape, head frame, no movement compensation; magnetometers after SSS
preprocessing.raw: standardised data as stored (no SSS), magnetometers

backward.method: LOTO (all of the subject's trials) ridge backward decoder, 102 magnetometers, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz; nulls per held-out trial: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and the other trials' envelopes (mismatch, np.resize); subject null = 2000 draws of one null value per trial; lag sweep +-1 s in 15.6 ms steps (positive = stimulus delayed), parabolic peak, subject bootstrap CI; tolerance 1 sample (15.6 ms)

latency_trf.method: forward TRF Hilbert envelope -> 102 magnetometers, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, lags -200..600 ms, ridge alpha 1; GFP per subject, mean over subjects; M50 = GFP max 30-80 ms, M100 = GFP max 80-160 ms (highest local maximum in the window; None if none)

latency_trf.method: forward TRF Hilbert envelope -> 102 magnetometers, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, lags -200..600 ms, ridge alpha 1; GFP per subject, mean over subjects; M50 = GFP max 30-80 ms, M100 = GFP max 80-160 ms (highest local maximum in the window; None if none)

sanity.note: flat = channel std < 1e-3 x median std over all 311 channels (any type)
